blocks.text: These terms govern the use of FoodSaaS, restaurant management software operated from Peru. By creating an account or signing in, the restaurant (the “Client”) accepts these conditions.
FoodSaaS is a technology tool. It does not replace legal, accounting, or tax advice. The Client is responsible for the accuracy of the information entered and for how the system is used.
The account is for internal use by the restaurant and its authorized staff. Sharing credentials, accessing other restaurants’ data, or using the service for unlawful purposes is prohibited.

Operational, customer, and sales data loaded into the tenant belongs to the restaurant. FoodSaaS does not sell or repurpose it. Support access, when provided, is limited to what is needed to resolve an incident and is logged.
We may suspend access for breach, security risk, or non-payment, with reasonable notice when possible. The Client may request cancellation and export of their information according to their plan.
This policy describes how personal data is handled in FoodSaaS, in line with Peru’s Law No. 29733, its regulations, and guidelines from the National Authority for Personal Data Protection (ANPDP).

There are two scopes. (1) Restaurant account and user data (email, name, role): FoodSaaS’s operator is the controller. (2) Customer, order, cash register, and inventory data: the restaurant is the controller. FoodSaaS acts as processor only to provide the service and follow the Client’s instructions.

Order, customer, billing, and operational communication data is stored separately per restaurant (tenant). It is not mixed with other restaurants or published. It is for internal use of that establishment, except where law or authority requires otherwise.

We do not sell databases. We do not use operational information for third-party advertising. Processing is limited to running the software, security, technical support, SaaS billing, and regulatory compliance.

If a customer or user exercises their rights, they may contact the restaurant first (for their record) or soporte@foodsaas.orvae.pe (for platform access). We will handle or forward the request according to the controller/processor role.

In Peru, personal data processing is mainly governed by Law No. 29733 and its regulations. Customer and restaurant-operation data is processed for a defined purpose: management authorized by the Client.

Principles we apply: lawfulness, consent where required, purpose, proportionality, quality, security, and available remedies. We do not collect data unrelated to the service. Consent for the restaurant’s database is obtained by the establishment in its relationship with the customer; FoodSaaS does not replace that duty.

ARCO and related rights (access, rectification, cancellation, objection, and others under applicable law): the data subject may exercise them with the controller. The restaurant must provide a channel; FoodSaaS will assist technically (correction, blocking, or deletion in the system when appropriate and not prevented by retention duties).

items: Internal purpose: tables, orders, inventory, cash register, and operational communications for that restaurant.
No transfer to third parties for commercial purposes.
Technical processors (hosting, email, messaging) only process what is necessary, with confidentiality measures.
Retention: while the restaurant keeps the account and for legal or accounting periods it must observe.
Transfer: servers are chosen with security criteria; cross-border flows will use safeguards required by Law No. 29733.

blocks.text: ANPDP is Peru’s administrative authority for personal data protection. Data subjects may file a complaint there if they believe their rights were violated, without prejudice to court action.
We use cookies and local storage strictly necessary to sign in, maintain the session, remember preferences (language, theme), and protect the service (for example CSRF tokens and abuse detection).
We do not install third-party advertising cookies or marketing profiles on operational data. If a non-essential cookie were added in the future, consent would be requested when the law requires it.
You may block cookies in the browser; some login or session features would stop working. “Keep me signed in” only extends access to the restaurant; it does not share data with ad networks.

Data is treated as internal, confidential information for each restaurant. We apply reasonable organizational and technical measures: tenant separation, encryption in transit (HTTPS), role-based access, logging of sensitive operations, and backups.
No system is invulnerable. The Client must use strong passwords, not share users, and sign out on shared devices. Restaurant staff should only access what their role allows.
Security incidents affecting personal data will be handled under applicable Peruvian law, including notification to the authority and data subjects when required.

FoodSaaS support does not use operational data to train third-party AI models or for purposes unrelated to the incident. Any human or automated assistance on the tenant is subject to this duty of confidentiality.
For platform help, email soporte@foodsaas.orvae.pe with the restaurant name and, if possible, the affected user. Do not send unnecessary customer data or full receipts by email.
Support is for operating the software (access, plans, technical issues). It is not a mailbox for other restaurants’ customer data.
ARCO or other personal-data requests may be sent to the same address with subject “Data protection”, to route them to the correct controller (restaurant or platform operator).
